channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Hunt hums past Rocky Mount 69-54 for 10th straight win
item.description: No. 5 Hunt defeated Rocky Mount 69-54 for its 10th straight win, staying unbeaten in Big East play behind Amere Hall’s 15 points and 8 assists ahead of a Jan. 20 showdown at Fike.

item.title: Firefighters battle wildfires in 2 counties
item.description: Wind-driven wildfires burned across 50–60 acres along East Langley Road in Wilson and Edgecombe counties Saturday.

item.title: Area Calendar, Jan. 19-20, 2026
item.description: Area sports calendar for Jan. 19-20, 2026, highlights college basketball, MLK Showcase high school games, winter track, swimming and a full slate of local matchups.

item.title: Georgia Tech hands NC State 78-74 setback as defensive progress, free throws unravel
item.description: Georgia Tech snaps a three-game skid with a 78-74 win at NC State, exposing the Wolfpack’s renewed defensive issues and late free-throw woes after a brief midseason surge.

item.title: Sleight goes wild as Bulldogs hammer Valkyries, 90-62
item.description: Layne Sleight’s season-high 31 points powered Barton to a 90-62 win at Converse, giving the Bulldogs season-best scoring, a 51-37 rebounding edge and a boost to 9-7, 5-3 in Conference Carolinas play.

item.title: Barton rallies to win at Converse, 89-86
item.description: Barton men erase eight-point halftime deficit with a hot-shooting second half to edge Converse 89-86 on the road, led by 17-point efforts from Isaiah Davis and J.J. Dancy and a decisive 37-30 rebounding edge.

item.title: Parking lot should be ready for Warbirds’ games
item.description: Wilson City Council OKs $1.07M Warbirds game day parking lot; advances Lake Wilson dam rehab, stormwater and traffic signal upgrades; and rezones 115 acres for 300-plus homes.

item.title: Exhibit presents artwork by Nash Art Club
item.description: Wilson Arts is hosting a joint exhibit featuring pieces by Nash Correctional inmates and the Wilson Active Artists Association.

item.title: Down to Business: Potters produces beads used every day
item.description: Wilson’s Potters Industries plant, located on Firestone Parkway, turns newly manufactured glass into 35 million pounds of reflective glass beads each year for road and airport markings.

item.title: Wilson County deed transfers recorded week of Jan. 5-9
item.description: Wilson County recorded 34 property transfers Jan. 5-9, from single lots and homes to commercial sites and large land tracts, with sale prices ranging from $30,000 to $809,500.
